baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a LED tub light 308D1661P001. A light fitted inside a dryer or washing machine that switches on and off as the door opens and closes. It consists of a printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) populated with an LED, a lens, a lamp base, PVC sealing, an O-ring and a wiring harness. The LED tub light 308D1661P001 is assembled in Thailand using components sourced from China.

The LED printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), populated with a South Korean LED, lens, lamp base, wiring harness and PVC sealing and O-ring are produced in China. 

Final assembly in Thailand: assemble the lens with the O-ring; assemble the PCBA to the lamp base; assemble the harness (connect the wires with the plug and the light head); seal and test.

prediction.decisive_step: Manufacturing and populating the LED PCBA and other components in China
prediction.reasoning: Consistent with CBP rulings N345862, N344188, and N350050, the country of origin of an LED lighting device is conferred by the printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) that serves as the light source, or where the majority of key components are made when final assembly is simple. Here, the LED PCBA and all other components (except the raw South Korean LED) are manufactured in China. The final assembly in Thailand is simple fitting and connecting that does not substantially transform the Chinese components.

prediction.decisive_step: SMT assembly of the LED PCBA and final assembly of the tub light in Thailand
prediction.reasoning: Consistent with CBP precedents (e.g., N345862, N338577, N335573), the LED PCBA imparts the essential character to an LED light fixture by serving as the light source and controlling electronics. verdict.reasoning: In N345899 (and similarly N309638 and N307989), CBP examined LED lighting products assembled from Chinese housings, lenses, and other components where the LED printed circuit board assembly (PCBA)—the light source—was produced in the assembly country via surface mount technology (SMT) placement of imported LEDs and electronic components onto a bare PCB, followed by reflow soldering, testing, and final assembly. CBP held that the LED PCBA is the most critical component of the light and that SMT production of the LED PCBA effects a substantial transformation. Moving the SMT production of the LED PCBA from China to Thailand shifts origin to Thailand.
